newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Syrian student turned businessman killed in Moscow.
newsitem.headline: Syrian student turned businessman killed in Moscow.

text.p: A 24-year-old student from Syria who was also an owner of a cafe has been shot dead in the Russian capital, police said on Tuesday.
Police identified the victim of Monday's shooting only as Khalil. He studied at Moscow's Energy Institute and ran a cafe there.

An unidentified gunman shot him twice as Khalil parked his cheap Russian-made Moskvich car near his house in central Moscow. Police sources said the killing could have been linked to Khalil's commercial activities.

In another murder case involving a businessman, a 24-year-old director of a commercial firm was found dead with a bullet in his head, also on Monday night, in his Lincoln limousine near Moscow's central Sukharevskaya square.
Contract murders and armed showdowns are frequent in Russia's new cut-throat business world, where organised mafia-style gangs are fighting for influence.
